Govt of Jammu & Kashmir(UT)
OFFICE OF THE ASSISTANT DIRECTOR,
DISTRICT EMPLOYMENT & COUNSELLING CENTRE, RAMBAN
Subject: Temporary Engagement of Motivators under Mission YUVA in district Ramban.
ORDER NO. 03 of 2026
DATED: 05.03.2026
In pursuance of the communication issued under Mission YUVA vide No.
ED/Plan/YUVA/2025-26/941-50 dated 13.09.2025 regarding the empanelment of Motivators,
and in continuation thereof, the Deputy Commissioner, Ramban issued advertisements for the
empanelment of Motivators under Mission YUVA in the district vide Notice No. 02 of 2025
dated 19.09.2025, issued under Endorsement No. DC/Rbn/PS/2025/90 dated 19.09.2025, and
Notice No. 06 dated 26.12.2025, issued under Endorsement No. DC/Rbn/PS/2025/135 dated
26.12.2025, it is notified as follows. A total of 44 applications were received. Upon scrutiny, 07
applications were found to be a duplicate submission and, therefore, were not considered for
empanelment. Scrutiny of applications was conducted by the Selection Oversight Committee and
after verification of eligibility, original documents, and automation based scoring, 37 candidates
were found eligible, out of which 26 candidates were recommended on merit for approval given
the mechanism devised for Empanelment in the district.
Now, on the basis of recommendations and approvals accorded by the District Level
Empanelment Committee, Ramban, sanction is hereby accorded to the temporary engagement of
the following 26 candidates as Motivators under Mission YUVA for District Ramban, against the
sanctioned strength, as per the details given below:

1. Duration of Contract and Renewal
➤ The initial engagement period shall be 11 months from the date of joining.
➤ Performance shall be reviewed as per predefined KPIs of Mission YUVA.
➤ Renewal for an additional 11 months may be granted based on satisfactory performance and
approval of the competent authority, subject to the project life cycle.
2. Roles & Reporting
The Empanelled personnel shall perform duties and report as prescribed in the Mission YUVA
Operational Guidelines.
3. Terms and Conditions:
The selected candidates shall report to the Assistant Director Employment, DE&CC Ramban
(Member Secretary Mission YUVA) within 07 days of issuance of this order, along with the
following original documents for verification and completion of joining formalities:
➤ Domicile Certificate
➤Date of Birth Certificate
➤ All Qualification Certificates
➤ Experience Certificates
➤ Undertaking
➤ Character Certificate issued by competent authority
Failure to report within the stipulated time shall be treated as unwillingness to join, and the next
eligible candidate from the waiting list shall be considered for Empanelment.
Monthly Consolidated remuneration shall be paid as per Mission YUVA norms, subject to
verification of all documents.
All other terms and conditions shall remain governed strictly under Mission YUVA
Operational Guidelines for Motivators engagements.
Assistant Director Employment,
Ramban
